title: The playback asset pool and DAWproject import refuse a WAV whose header declares more frames than it holds

needles: audio renderer refuses a truncated WAV asset the reader could recover
A truncated WAV is the opposite case and is refused in `decode_wav` itself.
it refuses a WAV the reader could only recover (`inspect_wav(...)->truncated`)

installed_sdk.rationale: No header, symbol, struct layout or serialized form of the playback or timeline modules changes. DecodedAudioAssetPool::decode_wav and DAWproject import keep their signatures and error codes; they refuse one more class of input (a truncated WAV) with the InvalidAsset and InvalidValue codes they already return. The AudioFileInfo fields they read belong to the audio module.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, handler or document shape changes; a project referencing a truncated WAV fails to load through the existing asset error path.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition, schema entry or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, grant or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json gains no capability for this; the refusal is an input-validation rule inside existing engine entry points.
